pr.title: feat(providers): append to pr template, not replace it
pr.body: Closes #235 - 🟣 ~~[feat(providers): append to pr template, not replace it (#238)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/238)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[fix(providers): don't post irrelevant stack siblings on PR/MR descriptions (#237)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/237)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: body_with_template returns the body unchanged whenever it already contains the template text, so a commit body that quotes the template gets no seam and the --desc block runs into it.
